technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with short-term bullish momentum (RSI14 rising, supertrend, psar) but conflicting intermediate/long-term weakness (below 50/200 MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF); stochrsi overbought adds caution.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 88 days create a low-conviction fundamental setup.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase, 1 exchange, 1 sale) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (433), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, NFP event imminent; earnings in 88 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly adverse.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (supertrend, psar, obv bullish; RSI rising) combined with extreme fear sentiment (16/100) and price near support (91.41) creates a contrarian swing entry opportunity with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), negative CMF/AO, stochrsi overbought, and zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional support, high earnings risk in 88 days) make this a high-risk fade into weakness.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (supertrend, psar, obv bullish) and extreme fear sentiment (16/100) create a contrarian setup at support; however, severe macro headwinds, price below all major moving averages, and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unfavorable for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (433), flat yield curve recession signal, and rising DXY create macro environment hostile to tech; earnings in 88 days add event risk with no institutional or insider support to validate conviction.
decision.recommended_exit: If entered despite recommendation: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at 88.50 (below current support); take profit at 95.00 (near 50-SMA resistance).
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show bullish momentum but fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly favor bear case; sentiment provides only weak contrarian signal without confirmation.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AMD with 18 other IT positions in 159-total portfolio; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further and warrant minimal sizing if entry forced.
